name: Treats for Greatfather Winter
summary: In Ironforge, the dwarf playing Greatfather Winter asks you for a holiday treat. Bring five freshly baked gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk, and he thanks you with a festive gift.

sections.title: A Long Day in the Seat
sections.body: Smokywood Pastures sponsors the Winter Veil festivities in Ironforge. By the holiday tree in the Commons, a performer sits dressed as Greatfather Winter. For hours, he hears holiday wishes from citizens and eager children. He wears the guise of an immortal figure from ancient titan lore and dwarven myth.

sections.title: Baking Holiday Cheer
sections.body: After hearing requests for gifts all day, the performer grows hungry. He asks for five freshly baked gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk. The simple meal gives the exhausted festival worker a moment of relief. Your kindness spreads goodwill through Ironforge.

faq.q: Where do I find Greatfather Winter in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Greatfather Winter sits beside the large holiday tree and the Smokywood Pastures display in the Commons of Ironforge, amid festive decorations.

faq.q: How do you make Gingerbread Cookies?
faq.answer: Smokywood Pastures vendors near Greatfather Winter sell the recipe. You need Cooking skill, holiday spices from the festival merchant, and small eggs gathered from wild birds to bake the cookies.

faq.q: Where do I get Ice Cold Milk?
faq.answer: Innkeepers, food vendors, and drink sellers in major Alliance cities sell Ice Cold Milk. You can find it in the taverns across Ironforge.

faq.q: Is this Greatfather Winter the real mythic figure?
aliases: who is the guy in ironforge
faq.answer: No. During Winter Veil, Smokywood Pastures hires a dwarf to portray the legendary figure associated with the titans.

faq.q: What does Greatfather Winter send you after finishing the quest?
faq.answer: After receiving the cookies and milk, Greatfather Winter thanks you with a Smokywood Pastures Gift Pack.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this specific quest?
faq.answer: This Ironforge offering is for Alliance travelers. Horde members have an equivalent offering that sends them to Greatfather Winter in Orgrimmar.

angles.text: As a cook, you bake gingerbread cookies with small eggs and holiday spices.
As a dwarf, you know Greatfather Winter as an ancient legend tied to the titans and winter’s bounty. In the Commons, the figure enjoys cookies, bringing the myth down to earth.
As an Alliance traveler, you find Winter Veil festivities in Ironforge. Visitors from across the Eastern Kingdoms gather by the holiday tree in the Commons.
